notes.title: Tombs Of Myra is now available!
notes.content:
Tombs Of Myra is now live.

I hope you'll like my little, interesting game. Please leave a review or feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454531/939fe395f9c8e88991f52817e88441fbf716cf77.jpg[/img]

As some of you asked me about the Soundtrack, you can listen or download to it for free on [url=https://joemanaco.bandcamp.com/album/tombs-of-myra]Bandcamp[/url].
